title: Reel · Myth Flip — "Just relax" and IVF (FertiQoL ask)
caption:
Myth: stress is why IVF fails. A BMJ 2011 review pooled 14 studies — no link. Ask your clinic for the FertiQoL questionnaire + a counsellor; ESHRE calls that standard care, not a favour.
Which myth should we flip next? 👇
www.aiforheratx.org
#ivf #infertility #ivfsupport #womensmentalhealth #fertilitycare #ttccommunity

scenes.text: "Just *relax* and it'll happen." Stress is not why IVF fails.
Everyone had advice. Nobody asked how she was actually holding up.
phrases: She read all three, put the phone face down, and went to work.

scenes.text: Priya, 36, kept a private list of everything she'd done wrong. None of it was the reason.
phrases: Cold chai on the counter, again.
She'd written a list: the coffee, the work stress, the crying.
She was auditing herself for a failure that was never hers.

scenes.text: Ask your clinic for the FertiQoL questionnaire and a counsellor referral, then walk most days.
phrases: Say it out loud at the next appointment: "I'd like the FertiQoL questionnaire."
Ask for a fertility counsellor — ESHRE 2015 calls this standard care, not a favour.
Then 20 minutes of walking, most days (WHO: 150 min a week) — for your mood, not your odds.
